To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
there are varying structures and social influences of online gaming communities.
online gaming guilds are formed by a group of individuals that share similar goals and are able to work together in order to accomplish them.
the social structures and influences of online gaming communities vary greatly and are affected by many different factors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the social structures and interactions of players in online gaming communities and how these interactions and structures affect the players and their guilds.
the structures, processes and dynamics that are unique to the virtual communities created by MMOGs.
the social interactions that occur in online gaming communities and how these communities are influenced by the social and cultural structures of the players.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the success of a group within a game is based on the players' ability to adapt to a changing environment and to work together as a team.
online games are not just a game, but a virtual society that is created and maintained by the players and their interactions with one another.
the online gaming community has become a unique culture in itself, one that is not only influenced by the game itself and the people involved but is also influenced by the real world.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the social structures and communication tools of online games have an effect on how players interact, how they are able to interact and the type of interactions that take place.
there are many different types of guilds and that the social interactions between players and guilds are not as simple as it would appear.
the communication tools used in online games are a key factor in the success of a group and that the culture of the community is a key component in the longevity of a guild.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the online community is a social construct that is constantly evolving.
the social interactions and the community that forms around a game can be a very important part of the experience and the community itself can become a very important part in a players’ life.
the community and its members have a strong effect on the player's experience and enjoyment of the game.
